Theme

Money, work & business · Town, shops & places

debit card noun

also bank card, cash card

* our formation

* (our own formation) tabella argentāria

a bank card

Our formation, on Traupman’s tabella tribūtāria for a credit card and his ratiō argentāria for a bank account (Traupman 276): argentārius is to do with banking, as in taberna argentāria, a banker’s stall (Liv. 26.11, in Lewis & Short). No reference work has a word for a debit card.

Other words

  • * (our own formation) chartula argentāria

    also used · * our formation

Examples

  • Tabellā argentāriā solvam.

    I’ll pay with my debit card.composed

See also credit card, bank account, cash machine, pay by card.

SourcesLewis & Short: chartula · Lewis & Short: argentarius

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
